meta.measuredAgainst: the spectro-server built from this tree, on 127.0.0.1:8236, fresh throwaway home (card 74: one filter fences every /api path, /api/health excepted)
meta.wsNote: The chat/run stream (/ws) and the PTY shell (/ws/shell) are WebSocket endpoints, origin-checked at handshake time. They are not REST and are not part of this collection.

fenceSemantics.host: Loopback fence: the TCP peer must be loopback AND the Host header must be localhost/127.0.0.1/::1. A REST client passes automatically when it targets http://localhost:<port>. A LAN IP or rebound DNS name in the URL answers a blank 404.
fenceSemantics.host+origin: Loopback fence plus Origin check: an Origin header, if present, must be loopback. REST clients send no Origin header, which counts as safe — requests pass. A manually added foreign Origin answers a blank 404.
fenceSemantics.host+origin+json: Loopback fence plus Origin check, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.
fenceSemantics.host+json: Loopback fence, and the request must carry Content-Type: application/json — anything else is 415.
fenceSemantics.host+json+optin: Loopback fence plus Content-Type: application/json, and the server must run with SPECTRO_ALLOW_SPAWN set (default off). Disabled and fenced-out both answer 404 — there is no enablement oracle.

meta.refusalShape: Every fence refusal is a blank 404, never a 403, so a refused caller cannot fingerprint the server.

fenceMeasurement.note: Measured with curl from loopback against a live spectro-server built from this tree (port 8236, 2026-08-04). A browserless REST client (no Origin header) passes every fence as long as it connects to loopback and targets localhost/127.0.0.1 in the URL. GET /api/health is the one path deliberately left open.

variables.note: Server host. The host fences require localhost/127.0.0.1/::1 here — a LAN IP answers 404 on every host-fenced endpoint.
spectro-server port. 8080 is the default; change once to re-target every request.
Composed base URL. Every request targets {{baseUrl}}.
A stored session id, shape [A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*. Take a real one from GET /api/sessions.
A fleet node id. Take a real one from GET /api/fleet.
A starter-bundle id from GET /api/bundles: five-lines | fleet | multi-agent.
A built-in model id from GET /api/local-model/catalog: qwen3-1-7b | qwen3-4b | qwen2-5-coder-7b | qwen3-8b | vibethinker-3b.
A content-addressed image name, [0-9a-f]{64}.(png|jpg|webp). Take a real one from a generate_image tool result.
A Claude Code transcript path from GET /api/claude/transcripts.
Root-relative file path inside the workspace, for GET /api/file.
An existing target folder for POST /api/bundles/{id}/scaffold.

endpoints.name: health probe
endpoints.description: Health probe; always {"status":"ok"} — reachability IS the signal.

endpoints.name: server log tail
endpoints.description: The rolling ~/.spectro/logs/spectroscope.log as tail + incremental deltas: {content, offset}. 256 KB response cap; rotation resets to a fresh tail.

query.name: offset
query.note: byte cursor from the previous poll

query.name: limit
query.note: tail lines for the no-offset form, max 1000

endpoints.name: scheduler job state
endpoints.description: The scheduler's job-state map from ~/.spectro/jobs-state.json (what `spectroscope cron status` prints); empty when absent/corrupt.

endpoints.name: list sessions
endpoints.description: List every stored session's metadata from the JSONL store (the sidebar list).

endpoints.name: session events
endpoints.description: All parsed RunEvents of one session as JSON; 404 when unreadable.

endpoints.name: export session JSONL
endpoints.description: The raw session JSONL, byte-identical, as an attachment (application/x-ndjson). Id shape-checked ([A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9-]*); 404 for foreign callers or malformed id.

endpoints.name: delete session
endpoints.description: Delete one stored session (JSONL + blob folder). 204 success, 400 malformed id, 404 unknown.
endpoints.caution: This really deletes the session, and it is the one destructive endpoint without an ORIGIN fence — the host fence and the id shape check are the guards, a foreign Origin from a local page is not refused here. Point it at a throwaway home before replaying the whole collection.

endpoints.name: active config
endpoints.description: Active provider/model/logLevel, image-key presence (booleans only), per-provider onboarding status incl. spectro-local.
endpoints.sideEffect: A ready provider establishes the 'provider-ready' leveling criterion — harmless, but a drift guard replaying the whole collection should know.

endpoints.name: save an API key
endpoints.description: Save an API key to ~/.spectro/.env (0600). 200 {saved:true,provider}, 400 unknown provider/empty key, 404 fenced out. Value never echoed.
endpoints.bodyNote: KeyBody(String provider, String key). Replace the placeholder key before sending.

endpoints.name: assembled system context
endpoints.description: The assembled system context (system prompt, tools, skills, MCP servers, subagent profiles) for the server's working directory — stateless.

endpoints.name: live model list
endpoints.description: Live model list for the picker (Anthropic Models API / /v1/models / ollama /api/tags), curated fallback; unknown provider answers [].

query.name: provider
query.note: anthropic | openai | lmstudio | openrouter | gemini | ollama

endpoints.name: reasoning capabilities
endpoints.description: Reasoning capability of one (provider,model) pair — control/efforts/wire; live API overlay for anthropic/ollama/openrouter, static table otherwise. Never errors.

endpoints.name: built-in model catalogue
endpoints.description: The built-in model catalogue: machine RAM/disk/binaryPresent plus every model's size, licence, download state and preflight verdict. Fenced — hardware fingerprint.

endpoints.name: model download status
endpoints.description: One model's download/presence state, polled for the progress bar. 404 for unknown ids.

endpoints.name: start model download
endpoints.description: Start (idempotent) one model's sha256-pinned download into ~/.spectro/models. Returns current status.
endpoints.caution: Downloads are gigabytes — do not include this in an automated replay.

endpoints.name: effective settings
endpoints.description: Effective config + per-field provenance + raw layers + file paths. 400 malformed session id, 404 session without workspace.

query.name: session
query.note: absent = process-moment view; present = session's workspace-joined view

endpoints.name: patch user settings
endpoints.description: Patch ~/.spectro/settings.json; answers the fresh process-moment view. 400 invalid patch, 500 I/O.
endpoints.bodyNote: Flat JSON patch; a null-valued entry removes that key; logLevel applies live.

endpoints.name: patch project settings
endpoints.description: Patch the session workspace's .spectro/settings.json; answers the fresh session-moment view.

endpoints.name: patch local settings
endpoints.description: Patch the workspace's .spectro/settings.local.json (gitignored — the writer ensures the .gitignore entry).

endpoints.name: list skills
endpoints.description: All skills of both roots (user ~/.spectro/skills + project <cwd>/.spectro/skills), disabled ones included: {skills:[{name,description,source,disabled}]}.

endpoints.name: disable / enable a skill
endpoints.description: Flip the .disabled marker on a skill (user root wins when both roots carry it). 404 unknown.

endpoints.name: delete a user skill
endpoints.description: Delete a USER-root skill for good (seeding ledger keeps it away). 409 for a project skill, 404 unknown. Traversal-guarded.
endpoints.caution: Deletion is permanent — the seeding ledger will not re-seed it.

endpoints.name: workspace tree
endpoints.description: That session's resolved workspace tree (dot-files and build/dep dirs hidden, depth 8, 2000-entry cap, honest truncated flag; a link out of the workspace is left out). 400 malformed session id or unknown scope, 404 no workspace folder, 409 no workspace resolved for this session. With scope=prospective: the folder a run started now would use, named by the server from the configured workspace and never by the caller (409 when none is configured).

query.name: session
query.note: the session whose resolved workspace to serve; absent = 409, there is no fallback; ignored under scope=prospective

query.name: scope
query.note: session (default) or prospective — the configured folder the first run will use, before any session exists

endpoints.name: one file (preview)
endpoints.description: One file for the preview pane, CSP-sandboxed. Real-path sandbox: no traversal and no symlink escape. 400 unknown scope, 404 outside/hidden/missing, 413 over caps (2 MB text / 25 MB image), 415 binary. With scope=prospective: the same file out of the folder a run started now would use, named by the server from the configured workspace and never by the caller (409 when none is configured) — the tree and the preview take the same two roots, decided by one rule.

query.name: session
query.note: the session whose resolved workspace holds the file; ignored under scope=prospective

query.name: scope
query.note: session (default) or prospective — the configured folder the first run will use, before any session exists

endpoints.name: native folder chooser
endpoints.description: Open the NATIVE macOS folder chooser on the server machine (blocks up to 120 s). 200 {path}, 204 cancel, 409 dialog already open, 501 non-macOS, 500 failure. Picks only — changes nothing.
endpoints.caution: Blocks until a human answers the dialog on the server machine — exclude it from automated replays.

endpoints.name: one stored image
endpoints.description: One generated image from the content-addressed store (~/.spectro/images). Name must match [0-9a-f]{64}.(png|jpg|webp) — 400 otherwise, 404 non-local/missing.

endpoints.name: copy image to workspace
endpoints.description: Copy a stored image into the session's workspace. 200 {path}, 400 malformed inputs, 404 unknown image/workspace, 409 target exists.
endpoints.bodyNote: CopyRequest(String file, String session, String name) — name optional (keeps store name; extension inherited).

endpoints.name: docker state on this machine
endpoints.description: Whether Docker and the compose v2 plugin are usable here: {docker, compose, remote, detail}. docker is ready/absent/stopped/unreachable, detail is one honest sentence. A DOCKER_HOST naming a remote daemon answers unreachable rather than a guess.

endpoints.name: list Claude Code transcripts
endpoints.description: List *.jsonl Claude Code transcripts under ~/.claude/projects, newest first, capped at 300 rows. Answers {limitBytes, truncated, transcripts: [...]} — truncated says the row cap fired, limitBytes is the ceiling the content endpoint enforces. Absent store = empty list.

endpoints.name: one transcript's JSONL
endpoints.description: One transcript's raw JSONL for the import path, streamed. 400 non-.jsonl, 404 outside base/missing, 413 over 128 MiB.

endpoints.name: tutorial state
endpoints.description: The tutorial + this home's progress: mode, level, marks, remaining, history.

endpoints.name: report a surface visit
endpoints.description: Report a surface was shown (how UI-only acts reach the tutorial). Returns fresh state.
endpoints.bodyNote: VisitBody(String surface, String sessionId, Integer agentsShown) — surface required to record, others optional.

endpoints.name: switch leveling mode
endpoints.description: Switch the leveling mode. 400 unknown mode.
endpoints.bodyNote: ModeBody(String mode) — ladder | checklist | off, exact match; a typo is 400.

endpoints.name: reset the tutorial
endpoints.description: Restart the tutorial from the dark frame, keeping the mode.
endpoints.bodyNote: No fields — an empty JSON object satisfies consumes=application/json.

endpoints.name: tick a criterion by hand
endpoints.description: Tick a criterion by hand — the receipt records origin=manual, forever.
endpoints.bodyNote: TickBody(String criterion). Unknown criteria are ignored by the recorder; state is still returned.

endpoints.name: fleet roster
endpoints.description: The fleet roster: {enabled, hubPort, nodes[]}. enabled:false with empty roster is a valid answer (hub is opt-in via SPECTRO_HUB_PORT).

endpoints.name: per-node replay
endpoints.description: Per-node replay from the bounded hub ring: {node, ringBounded:true, truncated, events[]}; 404 for unknown nodes.

endpoints.name: stop a node
endpoints.description: Dispatch ctl{stop} to a node over the hub. 202 sent (best-effort, no ack), 404 not local/no fleet/unknown, 409 node already left.
endpoints.bodyNote: No fields — an empty JSON object satisfies consumes=application/json.

endpoints.name: answer a parked gate
endpoints.description: Answer a parked permission gate on a fleet node. 202 sent, 400 missing callId/allow, 404, 409 node left.
endpoints.bodyNote: GateAnswer(String callId, Boolean allow) — both required; allow is boxed so a missing verdict is 400, never a silent deny.

endpoints.name: spawn a readonly node
endpoints.description: Spawn a readonly fleet node. 202 {id,note}, 400 bad input, 429 spawn cap, 500 process failure.
endpoints.caution: Requires the server to run with SPECTRO_ALLOW_SPAWN set AND a running hub — otherwise every answer is 404, by design.
endpoints.bodyNote: SpawnRequest(String prompt, String context, String role, String id, boolean linger) — prompt+context required; context matches [A-Za-z0-9._-]; the node is FORCED readonly.

endpoints.name: translation engine availability
endpoints.description: Which translation engines this install can offer: {local:{available,...}, cloud:{available,...}} with reasons no-binary | no-model | needs-key | provider-is-local.

endpoints.name: translate passages (NDJSON stream)
endpoints.description: Translate session passages, streamed NDJSON ({meta}, per-unit {unit,delta}/{unit,end}|{unit,error}, {done}). Never writes — the record survives. 400/413/503 as bounds/readiness dictate.
endpoints.bodyNote: TranslateBody(engine local|cloud, target en|de|uk|ru|fr|es|..., units[max 40, 4000 chars each, 60000 total]). The cloud engine spends the operator's API key.

endpoints.name: explain a run digest (NDJSON stream)
endpoints.description: LLM interpretation of a run digest, streamed as NDJSON ({meta}, {delta}..., {done}|{error}). 400 blank, 413 oversize, 503 no provider ready.
endpoints.caution: Spends the operator's API key on every call.
endpoints.bodyNote: ExplainBody(String digest, String lang) — digest required, max 200000 chars; lang en | de.

endpoints.name: speech to text
endpoints.description: Speech-to-text: webm→WAV (ffmpeg)→whisper-cli→{text}. 503 with setup hint when STT not installed, 500 temp-dir/interrupt. Sent without a body — as this request ships — Spring answers 400 (Required request body is missing) before the controller runs.
endpoints.bodyNote: Send the raw webm/opus recording as the request body (curl --data-binary @recording.webm). No JSON wrapper.

endpoints.name: probe the OTLP endpoint
endpoints.description: Probe the configured OTLP exporter endpoint with an empty batch: {configured:false} | {configured:true, endpoint, ok, message?}. Auth never echoed.

endpoints.name: starter-bundle catalog
endpoints.description: The starter-bundle catalog: {bundles:[{id,name,description,fleet}], buildTools:[gradle,maven,python,bash], version}.

endpoints.name: one bundle's files
endpoints.description: One bundle's rendered file set for copy-paste: {id, buildTool, files:{path:content}}. 404 unknown bundle.

endpoints.name: scaffold a bundle
endpoints.description: Write the bundle's files into a picked folder; refuses overwrites (409 with conflicts), rejects escaping paths. 200 {written, dir}. Answers 400 (Not a folder) until the target dir exists — the default {{scaffoldDir}} (/tmp/spectro-scaffold) is not created for you.
